patterns.note: Full-width sections are used throughout, often featuring large background imagery or solid color blocks, with content centered or aligned to a clear internal grid.
Key brand statements and section titles utilize an oversized, condensed serif typeface, creating a strong, editorial presence, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and product details.
A sophisticated, muted color palette dominates, combining deep charcoal and off-white with earthy browns and a subtle teal accent, reinforcing a premium and natural aesthetic.
A narrow promotional banner at the very top of the page remains sticky, providing a persistent message or offer as the user scrolls down the page.
Product display sections feature a clean, minimal grid of product cards, prioritizing large product imagery with subtle text details below each item.

technique_notes: To rebuild the sticky top banner, create a fixed-position element at the top of the viewport with a distinct background color and text, ensuring it has a high z-index to overlay other content during scroll.
The hero section combines a full-bleed, high-quality product photograph with large, condensed serif typography directly overlaid, using color contrast to ensure readability without a heavy overlay.

Product grids are constructed with a responsive layout, where each product card features a prominent image, a product title, and a price, all contained within a subtly rounded border and presented on a light background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed serif headings (~4-5x body) create a strong visual impact, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (small corner rounding on product cards, buttons, and input fields).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a tighter grid for product displays.

standout: The site's distinctive use of oversized, condensed serif typography for brand statements, layered directly onto rich, naturalistic product photography, creates a highly sophisticated and editorial feel that elevates it beyond typical e-commerce. The muted, earthy color palette further reinforces this premium, natural aesthetic.
